description: This is a Java interface file defining the ContentService interface for managing content-related operations within a content management system. It specifies methods for listing, retrieving, adding, updating, and removing content and associated files for merchant stores, including support for content types, files, logos, and images.

classes.name: ContentService
classes.description: An interface defining content management methods for CRUD operations, file handling, and listings related to content for merchant stores.

methods.name: listByType
methods.description: Lists content items by specified content type, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves content by its unique code within a merchant store, optionally considering language.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a content entity.

methods.name: addContentFile
methods.description: Stores a content file for a merchant store.

methods.name: addContentFiles
methods.description: Stores multiple content files for a merchant store.

methods.name: removeFile
methods.description: Removes a specific content file based on merchant store code and file name.

methods.name: removeFiles
methods.description: Removes all content files associated with a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all content files of a specific type for a merchant store.

methods.name: getContentFilesNames
methods.description: Fetches names of content files of a specific type.

methods.name: addLogo
methods.description: Adds a logo for a merchant store.

methods.name: addOptionImage
methods.description: Adds an option image for a merchant store.

methods.name: listByType (overload)
methods.description: Lists content by type for a store without language filtering.

methods.name: listNameByType
methods.description: Lists content descriptions by type for a store in a specific language.

methods.name: getByLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves content by ID and language.

methods.name: getBySeUrl
methods.description: Retrieves content description by store and SEO URL.
